cond_0001.intro:
As a Senior Analyst, you lead projects utilizing e-commerce website and app data to identify efficiency and growth opportunities within our partner's e-commerce platform, directly impacting their commercial decisions and enhancing the shopping experience for hundreds of thousands of end customers around the world.
""Provide the insight, advice and services to help our partners and prospects succeed and grow with their e-commerce platform""
You will also be helping to drive our profitability while continuously improving the services we deliver. Your insights will have a direct contribution to [Company name masked]'s long-term goal of changing the way the world shops.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Generate actionable insights to support our partners in optimizing their e-commerce platforms, leveraging Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics as your primary tools.
Conduct deep-dive analyses into website and app performance to identify trends and behavior patterns. Use your findings to propose enhancements that elevate the user experience and drive conversions. Expertise in A/B and multivariate testing (MVT) is essential for leading conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.
Establish foundational web and app analytics reporting for our partners. Ensure data integrity in reports and segments, and work collaboratively to address any data collection or implementation gaps in Adobe's ecosystem.
Forge strong relationships with our partners, acting as the contact between data insights and e-commerce optimization. You'll facilitate regular meetings, workshops, and presentations with our partners to ensure they're fully leveraging their e-commerce platform's potential. Comfort and proficiency in engaging with partner technology teams to refine data collection strategies are key.
Collaborate with partners to ensure effective utilization of customer data for marketing and e-commerce reporting within Adobe Analytics as a single source of truth.
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of our partner's marketing campaigns and present back findings.
Assisting our Partners' worldwide e-commerce operations. This entails providing valuable insights and recommendations, developing informative visualization dashboards using LookerML, conducting ad-hoc analysis, and conducting business reviews.
Problem Solving, with our department and business growing rapidly, and with even bigger growth plans ahead, new challenges and insights will develop for you to tackle.
Creating data to represent [Company name masked] Solutions' objectives and interests to other functions (e.g. Product Continuous Improvement).
Project Management and Support. Whether it is your own idea or a project managed by another department, you will be involved in supporting different projects across the business.
Engage with various teams across our partner's organization to uncover opportunities for growth and improvement. Your efforts will contribute to enhancing customer acquisition, increasing average order frequency and value, and minimizing churn.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Extensive knowledge using Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics
Leading projects within the CRO activities including AB and MVT testing
Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g. SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, VBA/AppScript, Data Studio/Tableau/Looker)
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of our partner's marketing campaigns
Strong communication with technical and non-technical senior management and key stakeholders
1 Degree in a STEM subject or equivalent work experience in a quantitative role
Analytical thinker who can break down complex problems
Able to use data to create compelling stories and achieve positive outcomes
Tenacity to follow ideas and problems through to resolution
Preferred Requirements
Python and Google Colab experience would be beneficial to the role
Experience adapting to a fast-changing environment
Willingness to travel internationally to meet with our [Product name masked] Partners
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value work that is useful to others and carried out with care. We believe strong organizations pay attention not only to outcomes, but also to how those outcomes affect people.

cond_0091.intro:
As a Senior Analyst, you lead projects utilizing e-commerce website and app data to identify efficiency and growth opportunities within our partner's e-commerce platform, directly impacting their commercial decisions and enhancing the shopping experience for hundreds of thousands of end customers around the world.
""Provide the insight, advice and services to help our partners and prospects succeed and grow with their e-commerce platform""
You will also be helping to drive our profitability while continuously improving the services we deliver. Your insights will have a direct contribution to [Company name masked]'s long-term goal of changing the way the world shops.
cond_0091.responsibilities:
Generate actionable insights to support our partners in optimizing their e-commerce platforms, leveraging Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics as your primary tools.
Conduct deep-dive analyses into website and app performance to identify trends and behavior patterns. Use your findings to propose enhancements that elevate the user experience and drive conversions. Expertise in A/B and multivariate testing (MVT) is essential for leading conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.
Establish foundational web and app analytics reporting for our partners. Ensure data integrity in reports and segments, and work collaboratively to address any data collection or implementation gaps in Adobe's ecosystem.
Forge strong relationships with our partners, acting as the contact between data insights and e-commerce optimization. You'll facilitate regular meetings, workshops, and presentations with our partners to ensure they're fully leveraging their e-commerce platform's potential. Comfort and proficiency in engaging with partner technology teams to refine data collection strategies are key.
Collaborate with partners to ensure effective utilization of customer data for marketing and e-commerce reporting within Adobe Analytics as a single source of truth.
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of our partner's marketing campaigns and present back findings.
Assisting our Partners' worldwide e-commerce operations. This entails providing valuable insights and recommendations, developing informative visualization dashboards using LookerML, conducting ad-hoc analysis, and conducting business reviews.
Problem Solving, with our department and business growing rapidly, and with even bigger growth plans ahead, new challenges and insights will develop for you to tackle.
Creating data to represent [Company name masked] Solutions' objectives and interests to other functions (e.g. Product Continuous Improvement).
Project Management and Support. Whether it is your own idea or a project managed by another department, you will be involved in supporting different projects across the business.
Engage with various teams across our partner's organization to uncover opportunities for growth and improvement. Your efforts will contribute to enhancing customer acquisition, increasing average order frequency and value, and minimizing churn.
cond_0091.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Extensive knowledge using Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics
Leading projects within the CRO activities including AB and MVT testing
Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g. SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, VBA/AppScript, Data Studio/Tableau/Looker)
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of our partner's marketing campaigns
Strong communication with technical and non-technical senior management and key stakeholders
1 Degree in a STEM subject or equivalent work experience in a quantitative role
Analytical thinker who can break down complex problems
Able to use data to create compelling stories and achieve positive outcomes
Tenacity to follow ideas and problems through to resolution
Preferred Requirements
Python and Google Colab experience would be beneficial to the role
Experience adapting to a fast-changing environment
Willingness to travel internationally to meet with our [Product name masked] Partners
cond_0091.values: We value work that is useful to others and carried out with care. We believe strong organizations pay attention not only to outcomes, but also to how those outcomes affect people.
cond_0091.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workforce that reflects society through inclusive programs and initiatives such as equal pay, employee resource groups, and inclusive benefits. We want employees from different backgrounds to feel supported and able to thrive.

cond_0123.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our team.
This role is within [Company name masked]'s Solutions division. Supporting our Partners around the world in a consistent way is essential to our long-term relationship with them; and to our commercial success. The Solutions teams provide all of our [Product name masked] Partners with wide-ranging remote and local support for their platform; so they can deliver their retail customer promises every day.
As a Senior Analyst, you lead projects utilizing e-commerce website and app data to identify efficiency and growth opportunities within our partner's e-commerce platform, directly impacting their commercial decisions and enhancing the shopping experience for hundreds of thousands of end customers around the world.
""Provide the insight, advice and services to help our partners and prospects succeed and grow with their e-commerce platform""
You will also be helping to drive our profitability while continuously improving the services we deliver. Your insights will have a direct contribution to [Company name masked]'s long-term goal of changing the way the world shops.
cond_0123.responsibilities:
Generate actionable insights to support our partners in optimizing their e-commerce platforms, regularly communicating findings using Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics as your primary tools.
Conduct deep-dive analyses into website and app performance to identify trends and behavior patterns. Share your findings directly with partners to propose enhancements that elevate the user experience and drive conversions. Expertise in A/B and multivariate testing (MVT) is essential for leading conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.
Establish foundational web and app analytics reporting for our partners. Ensure data integrity in reports and segments, and work collaboratively with partners to address any data collection or implementation gaps in Adobe's ecosystem.
Build strong relationships with our partners, acting as the ongoing contact between data insights and e-commerce optimization. You'll facilitate regular meetings, workshops, and presentations with our partners to ensure they're fully leveraging their e-commerce platform's potential. Staying in close contact with partner technology teams to refine data collection strategies is a key part of the role.
Collaborate daily with partners to ensure effective utilization of customer data for marketing and e-commerce reporting within Adobe Analytics as a single source of truth.
Quantify incremental uplift of our partner's marketing campaigns and present findings back to stakeholders clearly and confidently.
Support our Partners' worldwide e-commerce operations by providing insights and recommendations, developing visualization dashboards using LookerML, conducting ad-hoc analysis, and conducting business reviews.
Problem solving: with our department and business growing rapidly, new challenges and insights will develop for you to tackle and discuss with the wider team.
Create data to represent [Company name masked] Solutions' objectives and interests to other functions (e.g. Product Continuous Improvement), communicating clearly across teams.
Project Management and Support: whether it is your own idea or a project managed by another department, you will be involved in supporting and actively contributing to different projects across the business.
Engage regularly with various teams across our partner's organization to uncover opportunities for growth and improvement. Your efforts will contribute to enhancing customer acquisition, increasing average order frequency and value, and minimizing churn.
cond_0123.requirements:
Extensive knowledge using Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics
Experience leading projects within CRO activities including AB and MVT testing
Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g. SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, VBA/AppScript, Data Studio/Tableau/Looker)
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of our partner's marketing campaigns
Strong communication skills with technical and non-technical senior management and key stakeholders
1 Degree in a STEM subject or equivalent work experience in a quantitative role
Comfortable communicating with technical and non-technical senior management and key stakeholders
Analytical thinker who can break down complex problems
Python and Google Colab experience would be beneficial but not essential
Able to use data to create compelling stories and achieve positive outcomes
Tenacity to follow ideas and problems through to resolution
Experience adapting to a fast-changing environment
Willingness to travel internationally to meet with our [Product name masked] Partners

cond_0131.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our team.
This role is within [Company name masked]'s Solutions division. Supporting our Partners around the world in a consistent way is essential to our long-term relationship with them; and to our commercial success. The Solutions teams provide all of our [Product name masked] Partners with wide-ranging remote and local support for their platform; so they can deliver their retail customer promises every day.
As a Senior Analyst, you lead projects utilizing e-commerce website and app data to identify efficiency and growth opportunities within our partner's e-commerce platform, directly impacting their commercial decisions and enhancing the shopping experience for hundreds of thousands of end customers around the world.
""Provide the insight, advice and services to help our partners and prospects succeed and grow with their e-commerce platform""
You will also be helping to drive our profitability while continuously improving the services we deliver. Your insights will have a direct contribution to [Company name masked]'s long-term goal of changing the way the world shops. Most people become stronger in this kind of analytical work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0131.responsibilities:
Generate actionable insights to support our partners in optimizing their e-commerce platforms, leveraging Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics as your primary tools.
Conduct deep-dive analyses into website and app performance to identify trends and behavior patterns. Use your findings to propose enhancements that elevate the user experience and drive conversions. Expertise in A/B and multivariate testing (MVT) is essential for leading conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.
Establish foundational web and app analytics reporting for our partners. Ensure data integrity in reports and segments, and work collaboratively to address any data collection or implementation gaps in Adobe's ecosystem.
Forge strong relationships with our partners, acting as the contact between data insights and e-commerce optimization. You'll facilitate regular meetings, workshops, and presentations with our partners to ensure they're fully leveraging their e-commerce platform's potential. Comfort and proficiency in engaging with partner technology teams to refine data collection strategies are key.
Collaborate with partners to ensure effective utilization of customer data for marketing and e-commerce reporting within Adobe Analytics as a single source of truth
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of our partner's marketing campaigns and present back findings
Assisting our Partners' worldwide e-commerce operations. This entails providing valuable insights and recommendations, developing informative visualization dashboards using LookerML, conducting ad-hoc analysis, and conducting business reviews
Problem Solving, with our department and business growing rapidly, and with even bigger growth plans ahead, new challenges and insights will develop for you to tackle
Creating data to represent [Company name masked] Solutions' objectives and interests to other functions (e.g. Product Continuous Improvement)
Project Management and Support. Whether it is your own idea or a project managed by another department, you will be involved in supporting different projects across the business
Engage with various teams across our partner's organization to uncover opportunities for growth and improvement. Your efforts will contribute to enhancing customer acquisition, increasing average order frequency and value, and minimizing churn
cond_0131.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Extensive knowledge using Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics
Leading projects within the CRO activities including AB and MVT testing
Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g. SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, VBA/AppScript, Data Studio/Tableau/Looker)
Strong communication with technical and non-technical senior management and key stakeholders
1 Degree in a STEM subject or equivalent work experience in a quantitative role
Analytical thinker who can break down complex problems
Able to use data to create compelling stories and achieve positive outcomes
Tenacity to follow ideas and problems through to resolution
Preferred Requirements
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of our partner's marketing campaigns
Python and Google Colab experience
Experience adapting to a fast-changing environment
Willingness to travel internationally to meet with our [Product name masked] Partners

Supporting our Partners around the world in a consistent way is essential to our long-term relationship with them; and to our commercial success. The Solutions teams provide all of our [Product name masked] Partners with wide-ranging remote and local support for their platform; so they can deliver their retail customer promises every day.
As a Senior Analyst, you lead projects utilizing e-commerce website and app data to identify efficiency and growth opportunities within our partner's e-commerce platform, directly impacting their commercial decisions and enhancing the shopping experience for hundreds of thousands of end customers around the world.
""Provide the insight, advice and services to help our partners and prospects succeed and grow with their e-commerce platform""
You will also be helping to drive our profitability while continuously improving the services we deliver. Your insights will have a direct contribution to [Company name masked]'s long-term goal of changing the way the world shops.
cond_0154.responsibilities:
Generate actionable insights to support our partners in optimizing their e-commerce platforms, leveraging Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics as your primary tools.
Conduct deep-dive analyses into website and app performance to identify trends and behavior patterns. Use your findings to propose enhancements that elevate the user experience and drive conversions. Expertise in A/B and multivariate testing (MVT) is essential for leading conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.
Establish foundational web and app analytics reporting for our partners. Ensure data integrity in reports and segments, and work collaboratively to address any data collection or implementation gaps in Adobe's ecosystem.
Forge strong relationships with our partners, acting as the contact between data insights and e-commerce optimization. You'll facilitate regular meetings, workshops, and presentations with our partners to ensure they're fully leveraging their e-commerce platform's potential. Comfort and proficiency in engaging with partner technology teams to refine data collection strategies are key.
Collaborate with partners to ensure effective utilization of customer data for marketing and e-commerce reporting within Adobe Analytics as a single source of truth
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of our partner's marketing campaigns and present back findings
Assisting our Partners' worldwide e-commerce operations. This entails providing valuable insights and recommendations, developing informative visualization dashboards using LookerML, conducting ad-hoc analysis, and conducting business reviews
Problem Solving, with our department and business growing rapidly, and with even bigger growth plans ahead, new challenges and insights will develop for you to tackle
Creating data to represent [Company name masked] Solutions' objectives and interests to other functions (e.g. Product Continuous Improvement)
Project Management and Support. Whether it is your own idea or a project managed by another department, you will be involved in supporting different projects across the business
Engage with various teams across our partner's organization to uncover opportunities for growth and improvement. Your efforts will contribute to enhancing customer acquisition, increasing average order frequency and value, and minimizing churn
cond_0154.requirements:
Extensive knowledge using Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics
Leading projects within the CRO activities including AB and MVT testing.
Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g. SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, VBA/AppScript, Data Studio/Tableau/Looker)
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of our partner's marketing campaigns
Strong communication with technical and non-technical senior management and key stakeholders
Python and Google Colab experience would be beneficial to the role but not essential
1 Degree in a STEM subject or equivalent work experience in a quantitative role
Comfortable communicating with technical and non-technical senior management and key stakeholders
Analytical thinker who can break down complex problems
Python experience would be beneficial to the role but not essential
Able to use data to create compelling stories and achieve positive outcomes
Tenacity to follow ideas and problems through to resolution
Experience adapting to a fast-changing environment
Willingness to travel internationally to meet with our [Product name masked] Partners

cond_0220.intro:
This role is within [Company name masked]'s Solutions division. Supporting our Partners around the world in a consistent way is essential to our long-term relationship with them; and to our commercial success. The Solutions teams provide all of our [Product name masked] Partners with wide-ranging remote and local support for their platform; so they can deliver their retail customer promises every day.
As a Senior Analyst, you lead projects utilizing e-commerce website and app data to identify efficiency and growth opportunities within our partner's e-commerce platform, directly impacting their commercial decisions and enhancing the shopping experience for hundreds of thousands of end customers around the world.
""Provide the insight, advice and services to help our partners and prospects succeed and grow with their e-commerce platform""
You will also be helping to drive our profitability while continuously improving the services we deliver. Your insights will have a direct contribution to [Company name masked]'s long-term goal of changing the way the world shops. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of e-commerce data and how it connects to commercial outcomes.
cond_0220.responsibilities:
Generate actionable insights to support our partners in optimizing their e-commerce platforms, leveraging Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics as your primary tools.
Conduct deep-dive analyses into website and app performance to identify trends and behavior patterns. Use your findings to propose enhancements that elevate the user experience and drive conversions. Expertise in A/B and multivariate testing (MVT) is essential for leading conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.
Establish foundational web and app analytics reporting for our partners. Ensure data integrity in reports and segments, and work collaboratively to address any data collection or implementation gaps in Adobe's ecosystem.
Forge strong relationships with our partners, acting as the contact between data insights and e-commerce optimization. You'll facilitate regular meetings, workshops, and presentations with our partners to ensure they're fully leveraging their e-commerce platform's potential. Comfort and proficiency in engaging with partner technology teams to refine data collection strategies are key.
Collaborate with partners to ensure effective utilization of customer data for marketing and e-commerce reporting within Adobe Analytics as a single source of truth
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of our partner's marketing campaigns and present back findings
Assisting our Partners' worldwide e-commerce operations. This entails providing valuable insights and recommendations, developing informative visualization dashboards using LookerML, conducting ad-hoc analysis, and conducting business reviews
Problem Solving, with our department and business growing rapidly, and with even bigger growth plans ahead, new challenges and insights will develop for you to tackle
Creating data to represent [Company name masked] Solutions' objectives and interests to other functions (e.g. Product Continuous Improvement)
Project Management and Support. Whether it is your own idea or a project managed by another department, you will be involved in supporting different projects across the business
Engage with various teams across our partner's organization to uncover opportunities for growth and improvement. Your efforts will contribute to enhancing customer acquisition, increasing average order frequency and value, and minimizing churn
cond_0220.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Extensive knowledge using Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics
Leading projects within the CRO activities including AB and MVT testing
Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g. SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, VBA/AppScript, Data Studio/Tableau/Looker)
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of our partner's marketing campaigns
Strong communication with technical and non-technical senior management and key stakeholders
1 Degree in a STEM subject or equivalent work experience in a quantitative role
Analytical thinker who can break down complex problems
Able to use data to create compelling stories and achieve positive outcomes
Tenacity to follow ideas and problems through to resolution
Preferred Requirements
Python and Google Colab experience
Experience adapting to a fast-changing environment
Willingness to travel internationally to meet with our [Product name masked] Partners

""Provide the insight, advice and services to help our partners and prospects succeed and grow with their e-commerce platform""
You will also be helping to drive our profitability while continuously improving the services we deliver. Your insights will have a direct contribution to [Company name masked]'s long-term goal of changing the way the world shops.
cond_0271.responsibilities:
Generate actionable insights to support our partners in optimizing their e-commerce platforms, leveraging Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics as your primary tools.
Conduct deep-dive analyses into website and app performance to identify trends and behavior patterns. Use your findings to propose enhancements that elevate the user experience and drive conversions. Expertise in A/B and multivariate testing (MVT) is essential for leading conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.
Establish foundational web and app analytics reporting for our partners. Ensure data integrity in reports and segments, and work collaboratively to address any data collection or implementation gaps in Adobe's ecosystem.
Forge strong relationships with our partners, acting as the contact between data insights and e-commerce optimization. You'll facilitate regular meetings, workshops, and presentations with our partners to ensure they're fully leveraging their e-commerce platform's potential. Comfort and proficiency in engaging with partner technology teams to refine data collection strategies are key.
Collaborate with partners to ensure effective utilization of customer data for marketing and e-commerce reporting within Adobe Analytics as a single source of truth.
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of our partner's marketing campaigns and present back findings.
Assisting our Partners' worldwide e-commerce operations. This entails providing valuable insights and recommendations, developing informative visualization dashboards using LookerML, conducting ad-hoc analysis, and conducting business reviews.
Problem Solving, with our department and business growing rapidly, and with even bigger growth plans ahead, new challenges and insights will develop for you to tackle.
Creating data to represent [Company name masked] Solutions' objectives and interests to other functions (e.g. Product Continuous Improvement).
Project Management and Support. Whether it is your own idea or a project managed by another department, you will be involved in supporting different projects across the business.
Engage with various teams across our partner's organization to uncover opportunities for growth and improvement. Your efforts will contribute to enhancing customer acquisition, increasing average order frequency and value, and minimizing churn.
cond_0271.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Extensive knowledge using Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics
Leading projects within the CRO activities including AB and MVT testing
Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g. SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, VBA/AppScript, Data Studio/Tableau/Looker)
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of our partner's marketing campaigns
Strong communication with technical and non-technical senior management and key stakeholders
1 Degree in a STEM subject or equivalent work experience in a quantitative role
Analytical thinker who can break down complex problems
Able to use data to create compelling stories and achieve positive outcomes
Tenacity to follow ideas and problems through to resolution
Preferred Requirements
Python and Google Colab experience would be beneficial to the role
Experience adapting to a fast-changing environment
Willingness to travel internationally to meet with our [Product name masked] Partners
cond_0271.values: We value excellence, achievement, and delivering outcomes we can stand behind. We aim to bring high standards and a results-focused mindset to our work.
cond_0271.inclusion: However you identify or whatever your path here, women are especially encouraged to apply if you see a position that makes your heart skip a beat. Come join us and help us build a global company where we're all proud to belong. Confidence can sometimes hold women back from applying for a job. But here's a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. [Company name masked] is a place where every woman can grow and succeed. So, whatever your background and wherever you come from, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

cond_0350.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our team.
As a Senior Analyst, you will lead projects using e-commerce website and app data to identify efficiency and growth opportunities within our partners' e-commerce platforms, directly shaping their commercial decisions and improving the shopping experience for hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide.
""Provide the insight, advice and services to help our partners and prospects succeed and grow with their e-commerce platform""
You will also drive profitability while continuously improving the services we deliver. Your insights will directly contribute to [Company name masked]'s long-term goal of changing the way the world shops.
cond_0350.responsibilities:
Generate actionable insights to help partners optimise their e-commerce platforms, using Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics as your primary tools.
Lead deep-dive analyses into website and app performance to identify trends and behaviour patterns. Use your findings to propose enhancements that improve the user experience and drive conversions. Own conversion rate optimisation (CRO) initiatives through A/B and multivariate testing (MVT).
Establish foundational web and app analytics reporting for our partners. Ensure data integrity in reports and segments, and take ownership of addressing any data collection or implementation gaps in Adobe's ecosystem.
Build strong relationships with partners, acting as the primary point of contact between data insights and e-commerce optimisation. Lead regular meetings, workshops, and presentations to ensure partners are fully leveraging their platform's potential. Drive data collection strategy refinements in collaboration with partner technology teams.
Lead partners in ensuring effective utilisation of customer data for marketing and e-commerce reporting within Adobe Analytics as a single source of truth.
Quantify incremental uplift of partners' marketing campaigns and deliver findings back to stakeholders.
Direct support for partners' worldwide e-commerce operations by delivering insights and recommendations, building visualisation dashboards using LookerML, executing ad-hoc analysis, and leading business reviews.
Take on new challenges as the department and business grow, identifying and resolving emerging analytical problems.
Produce data outputs that represent [Company name masked] Solutions' objectives and interests to other functions (e.g. Product Continuous Improvement).
Manage and contribute to projects across the business, whether self-initiated or led by another department.
Engage with teams across partner organisations to uncover growth and improvement opportunities, contributing to customer acquisition, order frequency and value, and churn reduction.
cond_0350.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Extensive knowledge of Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics
Experience leading CRO projects including A/B and MVT testing
Experience with data analysis and visualisation tools (e.g. SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, VBA/AppScript, Data Studio/Tableau/Looker)
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of marketing campaigns
Strong communication skills with technical and non-technical senior management and key stakeholders
1 Degree in a STEM subject or equivalent work experience in a quantitative role
Analytical thinker who can break down complex problems
Able to use data to create compelling stories and achieve positive outcomes
Tenacity to follow ideas and problems through to resolution
Willingness to travel internationally to meet with [Product name masked] Partners
Preferred Requirements
Python and Google Colab experience
Experience adapting to a fast-changing environment
Due to the energizing nature of [Company name masked]'s business, vacancy close dates, when stated, are indicative and may be subject to change so please apply as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.
Please note: If you have applied and been rejected for this role in the last 6 months, or applied and been rejected for a role with a similar skill set, we will not re-evaluate you for this position. After 6 months, we will treat your application as a new one.

cond_0381.intro: We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our team.
cond_0381.responsibilities:
As a Senior Analyst, you lead projects utilizing e-commerce website and app data to identify efficiency and growth opportunities within our partner's e-commerce platform, directly impacting their commercial decisions and enhancing the shopping experience for hundreds of thousands of end customers around the world
""Provide the insight, advice and services to help our partners and prospects succeed and grow with their e-commerce platform""
You will also be helping to drive our profitability while continuously improving the services we deliver. Your insights will have a direct contribution to [Company name masked]'s long-term goal of changing the way the world shops.
Generate actionable insights to support our partners in optimizing their e-commerce platforms, leveraging Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics as your primary tools.
Conduct deep-dive analyses into website and app performance to identify trends and behavior patterns. Use your findings to propose enhancements that elevate the user experience and drive conversions. Expertise in A/B and multivariate testing (MVT) is essential for leading conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.
Establish foundational web and app analytics reporting for our partners. Ensure data integrity in reports and segments, and work collaboratively to address any data collection or implementation gaps in Adobe's ecosystem.
Forge strong relationships with our partners, acting as the contact between data insights and e-commerce optimization. You'll facilitate regular meetings, workshops, and presentations with our partners to ensure they're fully leveraging their e-commerce platform's potential. Comfort and proficiency in engaging with partner technology teams to refine data collection strategies are key.
Collaborate with partners to ensure effective utilization of customer data for marketing and e-commerce reporting within Adobe Analytics as a single source of truth
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of our partner's marketing campaigns and present back findings
Assisting our Partners' worldwide e-commerce operations. This entails providing valuable insights and recommendations, developing informative visualization dashboards using LookerML, conducting ad-hoc analysis, and conducting business reviews
Problem Solving, with our department and business growing rapidly, and with even bigger growth plans ahead, new challenges and insights will develop for you to tackle
Creating data to represent [Company name masked] Solutions' objectives and interests to other functions (e.g. Product Continuous Improvement)
Project Management and Support. Whether it is your own idea or a project managed by another department, you will be involved in supporting different projects across the business
Engage with various teams across our partner's organization to uncover opportunities for growth and improvement. Your efforts will contribute to enhancing customer acquisition, increasing average order frequency and value, and minimizing churn

Working knowledge of Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics
Experience leading projects within CRO activities including A/B and MVT testing
Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g. SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, VBA/AppScript, Data Studio/Tableau/Looker)
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of marketing campaigns
A 2.1 degree in a STEM subject, or equivalent work experience in a quantitative role, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

""Provide the insight, advice and services to help our partners and prospects succeed and grow with their e-commerce platform""
You will drive profitability while continuously improving the services we deliver. Your insights will directly contribute to [Company name masked]'s long-term goal of changing the way the world shops.
cond_0431.responsibilities:
Generate actionable insights to help partners optimise their e-commerce platforms, using Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics as your primary tools.
Lead deep-dive analyses into website and app performance to identify trends and behaviour patterns. Use your findings to propose enhancements that improve the user experience and drive conversions. Own conversion rate optimisation (CRO) initiatives through A/B and multivariate testing (MVT).
Establish foundational web and app analytics reporting for our partners. Ensure data integrity in reports and segments, and take ownership of addressing data collection or implementation gaps in Adobe's ecosystem.
Build strong relationships with partners, acting as the lead point of contact between data insights and e-commerce optimisation. Direct regular meetings, workshops, and presentations with partners to ensure they are fully leveraging their platform's potential. Engage confidently with partner technology teams to refine data collection strategies.
Lead partners in ensuring effective utilisation of customer data for marketing and e-commerce reporting within Adobe Analytics as a single source of truth.
Quantify incremental uplift of partner marketing campaigns and present findings back to stakeholders.
Drive partners' worldwide e-commerce operations by delivering valuable insights and recommendations, building visualisation dashboards using LookerML, conducting ad-hoc analysis, and leading business reviews.
Take on new challenges as the department and business grow, identifying and resolving emerging analytical problems.
Produce data outputs that represent [Company name masked] Solutions' objectives and interests to other functions (e.g. Product Continuous Improvement).
Manage and support projects across the business, whether self-initiated or led by another department.
Engage with teams across partner organisations to uncover growth and improvement opportunities, contributing to customer acquisition, order frequency and value, and churn reduction.
cond_0431.requirements:
Extensive knowledge of Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics
Experience leading CRO projects including A/B and MVT testing
Experience with data analysis and visualisation tools (e.g. SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, VBA/AppScript, Data Studio/Tableau/Looker)
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of partner marketing campaigns
Strong communication skills with technical and non-technical senior management and key stakeholders
1 Degree in a STEM subject or equivalent work experience in a quantitative role
Analytical thinker who can break down complex problems
Able to use data to create compelling stories and achieve positive outcomes
Tenacity to follow ideas and problems through to resolution
Experience adapting to a fast-changing environment
Willingness to travel internationally to meet with our [Product name masked] Partners
Python and Google Colab experience would be beneficial but not essential
cond_0431.values: We value excellence, achievement, and delivering outcomes we can stand behind. We aim to bring high standards and a results-focused mindset to our work.

This role is within [Company name masked]'s Solutions division. ""Provide the insight, advice and services to help our partners and prospects succeed and grow with their e-commerce platform""

Generate actionable insights to support our partners in optimising their e-commerce platforms, using Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics as your primary tools.

Serve as the point of contact between data insights and e-commerce optimisation for our partners. Conduct scheduled meetings, workshops, and presentations with partners to ensure they are making full use of their e-commerce platform. Coordinate with partner technology teams to refine data collection strategies.
Work with partners to ensure effective use of customer data for marketing and e-commerce reporting within Adobe Analytics as a single source of truth.
Quantify incremental uplift of partner marketing campaigns and document findings for relevant stakeholders.
Support our Partners' worldwide e-commerce operations by providing insights and recommendations, developing visualisation dashboards using LookerML, conducting ad-hoc analysis, and carrying out business reviews.
Identify and work through new analytical challenges as the department and business continue to grow.
Produce data outputs that represent [Company name masked] Solutions' objectives and interests to other functions (e.g. Product Continuous Improvement).
Provide support across projects, whether self-initiated or managed by another department.
Interface with teams across our partner's organisation to identify opportunities for growth and improvement, contributing to customer acquisition, order frequency and value, and churn reduction.

Extensive knowledge of Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics
Experience leading CRO projects including A/B and MVT testing
Experience with data analysis and visualisation tools (e.g. SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, VBA/AppScript, Data Studio/Tableau/Looker)
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of partner marketing campaigns
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting with both technical and non-technical senior management and key stakeholders
1 Degree in a STEM subject or equivalent work experience in a quantitative role
Able to use data to construct clear, evidence-based narratives and achieve positive outcomes
Tenacity to follow ideas and problems through to resolution
Willingness to travel internationally to meet with our [Product name masked] Partners
Preferred Requirements
Python and Google Colab experience
Analytical approach to breaking down complex problems
Experience working in a changing environment

Supporting our Partners around the world in a consistent way is essential to our long-term relationship with them; and to our commercial success. cond_0606.responsibilities:
As a Senior Analyst, you lead projects utilizing e-commerce website and app data to identify efficiency and growth opportunities within our partner's e-commerce platform, directly impacting their commercial decisions and enhancing the shopping experience for hundreds of thousands of end customers around the world
""Provide the insight, advice and services to help our partners and prospects succeed and grow with their e-commerce platform""

Comfort and proficiency in engaging with partner technology teams to refine data collection strategies are key.
Collaborate with partners to ensure effective utilization of customer data for marketing and e-commerce reporting within Adobe Analytics as a single source of truth
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of our partner's marketing campaigns and present back findings
Assisting our Partners' worldwide e-commerce operations. This entails providing valuable insights and recommendations, developing informative visualization dashboards using LookerML, conducting ad-hoc analysis, and conducting business reviews
Problem Solving, with our department and business growing rapidly, and with even bigger growth plans ahead, new challenges and insights will develop for you to tackle
Creating data to represent [Company name masked] Solutions' objectives and interests to other functions (e.g. Product Continuous Improvement)
Project Management and Support. Whether it is your own idea or a project managed by another department, you will be involved in supporting different projects across the business
Engage with various teams across our partner's organization to uncover opportunities for growth and improvement. Your efforts will contribute to enhancing customer acquisition, increasing average order frequency and value, and minimizing churn

Experience leading projects within CRO activities including AB and MVT testing
Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g. SQL, Excel/Google Sheets, VBA/AppScript, Data Studio/Tableau/Looker)
Ability to quantify incremental uplift of our partner's marketing campaigns
Comfort communicating with technical and non-technical senior management and key stakeholders
